meta.description: Registry for bounded selection-reconstruction limit conditions and candidate modes in Phase 3.

reconstruction_limit_entries.name: Selection Reconstruction Limits
reconstruction_limit_entries.purpose: Represent bounded reconstruction ambiguity and observable-selection recovery limits across recursive admissibility structures.

reconstruction_conditions.name: partial_selection_reconstruction_permitted
reconstruction_conditions.description: Formal support for recovering a subset of selection parameters from observed events.

reconstruction_conditions.name: multi_valued_preimage_structure_preserved
reconstruction_conditions.description: Reconstruction must not collapse multiple possible preimages into a single false unique result.

reconstruction_conditions.name: noninvertible_transport_preserved
reconstruction_conditions.description: Propagation history reconstruction must respect the path-dependent non-invertibility of NavT.

reconstruction_conditions.name: orientation_sensitive_reconstruction_remains_bounded
reconstruction_conditions.description: Reconstructing orientation frames from directional updates must stay within stable basin bounds.

reconstruction_conditions.name: observable_projection_does_not_force_unique_preimage
reconstruction_conditions.description: Mapping from projected observables back to process states must acknowledge information loss.

reconstruction_conditions.name: recursive_reconstruction_updates_remain_admissible
reconstruction_conditions.description: Each step in an iterative reconstruction must satisfy current process admissibility windows.

reconstruction_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_reconstruction_witness
reconstruction_conditions.description: Reconstruction of pruned branches must not imply unrecoverable selection bias.

reconstruction_conditions.name: reconstruction_instability_detectable
reconstruction_conditions.description: Formal mechanisms must exist to detect and register divergence or aliasing in reconstruction.
